01

“O Haman, build for me a tower”

An explanation transmitted from Ibrāhīm (Q 40:36).

849
Explanation from Ibrāhīm No. 849: 1

Ibrāhīm

English
Transmission wording
849: 1. Sufyan, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, on His words
"O Haman, build for me a tower": He said, he built it with baked brick. He said, they disliked building with baked brick and putting it in a grave (verse 36).
العربية
849: 1 سُفْيَانُ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي قَوْلِهِ يَا هَامَانُ ابْنِ لِي صَرْحًا قَالَ بَنَاهُ بِالآجُرِ قَالَ وَكَانُوا يَكْرَهُونَ أَنْ يَبْنُوا بالآجر ويجعلوه في القبر (الآية 36) .

02

“Indeed, the transgressors are the companions of the Fire”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 40:43).

850
Explanation from Mujāhid No. 850: 2

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
850: 2. Sufyan, from a man, from Mujahid, on His words
"Indeed, the transgressors are the companions of the Fire": He said, those who shed blood unjustly (verse 43).
العربية
850: 2 سُفْيَانُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ في قوله إن المسرفين هم أصحاب النار قال سفكة غير الدماء بغير حقها (الآية 43) .
Edition record 371502 · p. 263Link to report ↗
03

Verse 46

An explanation transmitted from Huzayl ibn Shurahbil (Q 40:46).

851
Explanation from Huzayl ibn Shurahbil No. 851: 3

Huzayl ibn Shurahbil

English
Transmission wording
851: 3. Sufyan, from Abu Qays, from Huzayl ibn Shurahbil, who said:
The souls of Pharaoh's people are in the bellies of black birds that go out morning and evening to the Fire; that is their being exposed to it (verse 46).
العربية
851: 3 سفيان عَنْ أَبِي قَيْسٍ عَنْ هُزَيْلِ بْنِ شُرَحْبِيلَ قَالَ إِنَّ أَرْوَاحَ آلِ فِرْعَوْنَ فِي أَجْوَافِ طَيْرٍ سود تغدوا وَتَرُوحُ عَلَى النَّارِ فَذَلِكَ عَرْضُهَا (الآية 46) .

04

“the Day the witnesses will stand”

Two explanations transmitted from al-Aʿmash and ʿAṭāʾ (Q 40:51).

852
Explanation from al-Aʿmash No. 852: 4: 5

al-Aʿmash

English
Transmission wording
852: 4:5. Sufyan, from al-Amash, who said:
I asked Mujahid about the words of God "the Day the witnesses will stand": He said, the angels (verse 51).
العربية
852: 4: 5 سفيان عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ مُجَاهِدًا عن قول الله يوم يقوم الاشهاد قال الملائكة (الآية 51) .
Edition record 371502 · p. 263Link to report ↗
853
Report from ʿAṭāʾ No. 853: 5: 4

ʿAṭāʾ

English
Transmission wording
853: 5:4. Sufyan, from Ibn Jurayj, from Ata, who said:
When there was revealed "Indeed, those who are too arrogant to worship Me will enter Hell, humiliated" (verse 60), they said, "If only we knew what hour it is." So there was revealed "And when My servants ask you about Me, indeed I am near; I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me."
العربية
853: 5: 4 سفيان عن بن جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ قَالَ لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عبادتي سيدخلون جهنم داخرين الآية 60 فَقَالُوا لَوْ عَلِمْنَا أَيَّ سَاعَةٍ هِيَ فَنَزَلَتْ وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ الداع إذا دعان
